title: Independence of the entries within a row
statement: Draw a $k \times d$ real matrix $\omega = (\omega_{ij})$ from the joint measure under which all $k \cdot d$ entries are independent and identically distributed Rademacher variables, each taking the values $-1$ and $+1$ with probability $1/2$. Then for every fixed row index $i \in \{1,\dots,k\}$, the family of coordinate maps $\bigl(\omega \mapsto \omega_{ij}\bigr)_{1 \le j \le d}$ — the $d$ entries lying in row $i$ — is mutually independent.
hypotheses_covered: ω drawn from the joint Rademacher product measure on the k×d array
fixed row index i among the k rows
replaced:
For each fixed row $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,k$, the $d$ functions
$j \mapsto \omega_{ij}$ are mutually independent under the joint measure.
